scene_description: Ruộng bậc thang mùa lúa chín, có sương sớm và nhà sàn.
Night market lit by hundreds of silk lanterns along an old river street.
Busy floating market at sunrise with dozens of boats selling fruit.
An old wooden ferry crossing a calm river between limestone karsts at dawn, a 1970s village on the bank.

A long journey south along the coast: mangrove forests, fishing villages and mudflats at low tide, filmed over several days. Then the road continues to the next province.
